The paragraph describes a bank implementing background checks on new employees in accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA). This action is compliant with legal standards, as the FCRA regulates the collection, dissemination, and use of consumer credit information, including the proper procedures for conducting background checks for employment purposes. By ensuring their checks meet FCRA standards, the bank is adhering to federal regulations designed to protect consumer privacy and ensure accuracy in reporting.
